variants.name: segmented-storage
variants.title: Segmented storage
variants.prompt: Create ONE finished high-quality PORTRAIT MOBILE GAME UI mockup for Rocket Raja's AFK / OFFLINE EARNINGS panel. Use reference image 1 as the FUNCTIONAL SOURCE for the new storage-meter concept; it has desktop sliders on the left: OMIT ALL desktop controls, sidebars, browser chrome and explanatory review text. Reference image 2 supplies the established GAME LOOK and dimmed fireworks-stall backdrop. Output ONLY one tall portrait game viewport, about 390×844 proportions; no device bezel, no multi-panel montage, no variation number in the artwork. A single refined ivory-paper popup dominates the viewport, with the darkened Indian fireworks shop and Player/Products/Legacy/Shop navigation faintly visible behind it. Approved art direction: Gouache Storybook / Ivory Bazaar; tactile pale parchment, strong cobalt typography and buttons, restrained warm gold edges, tiny floral corners, painted rupee coins. Exactly ONE perimeter frame, no extra outer border or pale margin around it. VARIATION 1, 'Segmented storage': Make the main visual a LARGE HORIZONTAL STORAGE BAR divided into EIGHT beautiful gold-filled segments, each representing one stored hour. All eight segments are full. Put '8h / 8h' clearly inside or directly above the bar and a tiny 'Cap reached' flag at its right end. Put scale labels '0h' and '8h cap' beneath. A distinct small muted note reads '2h beyond cap'. Above this meter, show a restrained painted coin pile and the large current reward ₹147.45M. Below the bar, three small readable stat groups show Away 10h, Credited 8h, and a half-filled circular efficiency indicator labeled 50%. Add a slim optional-ad ribbon with 'With an ad: ₹294.90M'. Cleanest, most compact and immediately readable layout. Warm gold bar on ivory paper, cobalt outlines. Fixed truthful data: 10 hours away, only 8 hours credited because the storage cap is 8 hours; therefore 2 hours are beyond the cap. Earning efficiency is 50% and is separate from the stored-time fill. Current/base earned cash is exactly ₹147.45M. A completed optional rewarded ad makes the total exactly ₹294.90M. Never present the doubled amount as already owned. Header title exactly 'Welcome back', with a small blue outlined CIRCLE containing lowercase serif 'i' at top-left, and a blue square close X at top-right. Keep the two same full-width footer buttons: primary cobalt 'Watch ad for 2× rewards' and quieter ivory 'Continue'. Both must have comfortable phone-size tap areas and clear spacing. No new controls, no extra claim button, no help banner, no new mechanics or currencies. All displayed text must be crisp, correctly spelled and comfortably readable. Create an attractive polished proposal with a substantially distinct composition while retaining this exact functionality.
